title: Scalar restriction commutes with the recorded direct-image presentation
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative unital rings, φ:A→B and g:Z→Y a morphism of schemes. For every unbounded fixed pro-etale derived B-module L, the A-direct image of realizationRestrictionIso at Z, followed by directImagePresentation for A on the scalar restriction of L, followed by A-realization of fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage, equals directImageScalarRestrictionIso on B-realization of L, followed by intrinsic scalar restriction of directImagePresentation for B, followed by realizationRestrictionIso at Y on the B-direct image of L. Use exactly the recorded presentations [def-sp-et-proet-coefficient-transport], the intrinsic restriction comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], and the fixed scalar restriction comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. This is the scalar-restriction face alone; it contains no scalar extension mate, open extension, compactification or properness hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 03D3, 0D6E, 0D6J and 07A6; restriction face of the proper-factor normalization of the recorded compact scalar comparison.

proof.text: The unit-normalized openSquarePullbackModel is the left-adjoint uniqueness comparison induced by the section-identity isomorphism of the two ordinary direct images. Its recorded right-adjoint uniqueness comparison is therefore that section-identity isomorphism; prove this by the adjunction Hom bijection, counit naturality and the two inverse identities.

The ordinary ring-sheaf restriction comparison is the ordinary section-pushforward comparison conjugated by these two section-identity isomorphisms. Its defining section equation gives uniqueness. Transfer the inverse direct-image realization normalization through the derived model isomorphism, using naturality and compatibility of rightDerivedFunctorNatIso with derived units. Paste these normalizations with the normalized ring-sheaf restriction square and the fixed scalar restriction square. The existing ordinary realization/restriction cube supplies the ordinary face; the proved normalized derived cube then gives the corresponding cube for directImagePresentation.

from.place: Recorded ring-sheaf direct-image restriction cube, used to prove the proper scalar factor.

lean.statement:
theorem recordedRestriction_directImage_cube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (L : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)))) :
    (directImageConstantPush A g).map
        ((FiniteCompactScalar.realizationRestrictionIso φ Z).hom.app L) ≫
      (directImagePresentation A g).hom.app
        ((@Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars.{u} Z.ProEt inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (ProEt.topology Z)
          (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) inferInstance inferInstance
          (uliftRingHom φ)).obj L) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y A).functor.map
        ((fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage (uliftRingHom φ) g).hom.app L) =
    (directImageScalarRestrictionIso φ g).hom.app
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z B).functor.obj L) ≫
      (scalarRestriction φ Y).map ((directImagePresentation B g).hom.app L) ≫
      (FiniteCompactScalar.realizationRestrictionIso φ Y).hom.app
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj L)
